svg.title: Displacement orders by municipality
svg.desc: Municipalities shaded by the number of displacement order records naming a town in them, 1 March to 14 October 2026, with the areas of the orders that name a whole region outlined.
svg.text: Records naming a town in the
A record is one town, or one region, named in one order.
Not shaded: 36 records naming no town (14 name the regions outlined here, 16 name Beirut's southern suburbs, beyond this map, and 6 name other targets); 26
naming a place with no mapped point; 14 naming towns beyond this map (Baabda 8, Baalbek 6). The 5 records for Tyre and its camps also name its towns and
